dict.string: Familiar records your microphone when you record a meeting, and writes down what's said on this Mac. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Familiar records your Mac's sound when you record a meeting, so the other people on a call are in the transcript. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Familiar asks QuickTime Player to open a recording or video at the moment that matched your search.
Familiar reads the files on your Desktop so you can search them by what's in them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Familiar reads your documents so you can search them by what's in them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Familiar reads your downloads so you can search them by what's in them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Familiar reads the folders you chose on this network disk so you can search them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
